hypothesis.statement: A close beyond a recent rolling price range starts a directional continuation that persists until a shorter opposite range breaks.
hypothesis.economic_rationale: A range escape can reveal information-driven order imbalance; the shorter exit channel responds when that imbalance reverses.

direction.long: Buy a close above the highest high of the previous 20 completed one-hour bars.
direction.short: Sell a close below the lowest low of the previous 20 completed one-hour bars.

signal.calculation: On RTH-aligned one-hour bars, compute the entry Donchian channel from the previous 20 bars and exit channel from the previous 10 bars, always excluding the current bar.
signal.signal_timestamp: Close of the completed one-hour breakout bar.

entry.condition: Close strictly beyond the corresponding prior 20-bar channel and no open position; simultaneous long and short signals are invalid.
entry.execution_price: Next one-minute bar open after the one-hour close, with adverse rounding and one tick slippage.
entry.execution_delay: One one-minute execution bar after signal close.
entry.last_entry_policy: No new position may be opened after this timestamp. Strategy-specific entry rules may impose an earlier effective cutoff.

exit.stop: Channel exit: long exits after a completed one-hour close below the prior 10-bar low; short exits above the prior 10-bar high. Execute at the next one-minute open.
exit.time_exit: No multi-session holding; the 16:08 Topstep hard flatten overrides the channel exit.

session_flatten.cash_close_action: No automatic flatten unless exit.time_exit explicitly says cash close.
session_flatten.execution: Exit at the open of the 16:08 one-minute bar. If that exact bar is absent, use the last available close strictly before 16:08. No position may remain afterward.
session_flatten.post_cash_close_monitoring: From 16:00 through hard flatten, accept no new entries or strategy signals; continue monitoring already-known stops and targets on one-minute bars.

early_close_exception.last_entry_time: min(strategy last_entry_time, early close minus 5 minutes)

data_requirements.bar_timestamp_semantics: Input timestamp is bar open; resampled signal intervals are left-closed/right-open and become observable at interval end.
notes: One-minute execution data must extend through the applicable hard-flatten timestamp.
An official CME equity-index-futures calendar with early-close timestamps is mandatory; do not infer an early close from missing bars.
One-hour bars are aligned from 09:30; only complete bars are eligible for signals.

structural.name: signal_timeframe
structural.description: Frozen signal timeframe selected without performance evidence.

structural.name: breakout_confirmation
structural.description: Close confirmation avoids intrabar ordering ambiguity.

risk_management.name: fixed_quantity
risk_management.description: One contract keeps baseline sizing independent of signal logic.

risk_management.name: hard_flatten_time
risk_management.description: No strategy position may remain open after the Topstep hard flatten.

risk_management.name: atr_position_sizing
risk_management.description: Published ATR sizing is separated from alpha for the common baseline.

execution.name: commission_per_side_usd
execution.description: Fixed commission on entry and exit.

execution.name: slippage_ticks_per_side
execution.description: Adverse slippage applied on entry and exit.

execution.name: session_timezone
execution.description: All session times use New York civil time and DST.

execution.name: cash_close
execution.description: Regular-day cash-session close; it is not an automatic flatten unless a strategy explicitly exits there.

execution.name: last_entry_time
execution.description: No new position may be opened after this time.

execution.name: forced_flatten_time
execution.description: Regular-day Topstep hard flatten; no position may remain afterward.

execution.name: early_close_calendar
execution.description: Required source for early-close timestamps; never infer them from missing bars.

execution.name: early_close_last_entry_buffer_minutes
execution.description: On an early-close day, stop new entries five minutes before the official close.

execution.name: early_close_flatten_buffer_minutes
execution.description: On an early-close day, hard-flatten one minute before the official close.

execution.name: position_policy
execution.description: At most one open position; no scaling or pyramiding.

execution.name: bar_conflict_policy
execution.description: Conservative ordering when stop and target occur in one execution bar.

execution.name: missing_execution_bar_policy
execution.description: Skip a fill if the exact required next one-minute bar is absent.

execution.name: price_rounding_policy
execution.description: Order levels are rounded to a valid tick without improving the assumed fill.

lookahead_risks.risk: Using a signal bar's final high, low, close, volume, or indicator value before that bar closes.
lookahead_risks.control: All signal calculations use completed bars only; no order based on that bar can fill before its close.

lookahead_risks.risk: Rolling windows accidentally include future bars or the current breakout observation in their reference level.
lookahead_risks.control: Windows are trailing and causal; reference highs/lows explicitly exclude the bar being evaluated when stated by the strategy.

lookahead_risks.risk: Including the breakout bar in its own 20-bar channel makes a strict breakout impossible or biased.
lookahead_risks.control: Shift both Donchian channels by one completed signal bar.

same_bar_risks.risk: A target and stop can both lie inside the same one-minute bar.
same_bar_risks.control: Record the stop first, the conservative path, because intraminute ordering is unavailable.

same_bar_risks.risk: A close-confirmed signal cannot be filled at that same close.
same_bar_risks.control: Use the exact next one-minute open and apply adverse slippage; skip the signal when that bar is missing.

execution_ambiguities.risk: The source cards do not define a universal execution and cost model.
execution_ambiguities.control: Use one MNQ contract, one tick adverse slippage per side, and USD 1.25 commission per side from repository defaults.

execution_ambiguities.risk: The source cards do not consistently define end-of-session handling.
execution_ambiguities.control: Treat 16:00 cash close, the last-entry cutoff, and the 16:08 Topstep hard flatten as distinct events. Continue risk exits after cash close, but never retain a position after hard flatten.

execution_ambiguities.risk: CME holiday sessions can close before the regular cash close and hard-flatten times.
execution_ambiguities.control: Require the official CME early-close timestamp; set last entry to min(strategy cutoff, early close minus five minutes) and hard flatten to min(16:08, early close minus one minute). Reject the session if the calendar value is unavailable.

remaining_assumptions.description: Indicators and signal bars use only 09:30–16:00 RTH observations; completed prior sessions may remain in rolling history.
The signal timeframe is selected from the horizons published on the source card for mechanical compatibility with its rule, without performance comparison.
All strategy baselines use exactly one MNQ contract and no pyramiding.
All strategies share the repository's fixed MNQ commission, tick size, and slippage defaults.
On official CME early-close days, last entry is five minutes before the early close and hard flatten is one minute before it.
A breakout requires the completed one-hour close beyond the prior channel, rather than an intrabar touch.
